title: rag-bench-spec template variables
description: Values for templates/rag-bench-spec.md.j2 and templates/rag-bench-spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from rag-bench-spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

corpus_sha.title: Corpus sha
corpus_sha.description: Content hash of the exact corpus snapshot this run indexed. Without it a re-run that scores differently tells you nothing about the change you were testing.

corpus_table.title: Corpus table
corpus_table.description: The warehouse table the corpus is read from, as schema.table. Pin a table, never a view - a view can change under the benchmark and the scores quietly stop comparing.

dense_model.title: Dense model
dense_model.description: Embedding model and version behind the dense runner. Changing it invalidates every stored vector, so record which one produced these numbers before anyone tries to reproduce them.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Handle of the engineer who owns the harness. When a number moves, this is the person who has to say whether the retriever changed or the corpus did.

query_repo.title: Query repo
query_repo.description: The git repo holding eval/queries.jsonl and its gold labels. Queries belong in git so a reviewer can see the commit where the benchmark got easier.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case id for this benchmark run, naming the corpus and the date - "support-kb-2026-08". Every number below is only comparable to runs sharing this id's corpus.
